private:
    int head[MAXN], to[MAXM], nxt[MAXM], cap[MAXM], ptr, sink;
    long long cost[MAXM], total_cost;
    inline void add_edge_raw(int u, int v, long long w, int c) {
        to[ptr] = v; cost[ptr] = w; cap[ptr] = c;
        nxt[ptr] = head[u]; head[u] = ptr++;
    }
    int dist[MAXN], id[MAXN], cur[MAXN]; bool inq[MAXN];
    bool spfa(int s, int t) {
        memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));
        memset(dist, -1, sizeof(dist));
        deque<int> q; q.push_back(s);
        dist[s] = 0; id[s] = 1;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop_front(); inq[u] = 0;
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (cost[i] && (dist[to[i]] == -1 || dist[to[i]] > dist[u] + cap[i])) {
                    dist[to[i]] = dist[u] + cap[i];
                    if (!inq[to[i]]) {
                        inq[to[i]] = 1;
                        q.push_back(to[i]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return dist[t] != -1;
    }
    long long dfs(int u, long long flow) {
        if (u == sink) return flow;
        inq[u] = 1;
        long long pushed = flow;
        for (int i = (cur[u] != -1 ? cur[u] : head[u]); i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
            if (!inq[to[i]] && cost[i] && dist[to[i]] == dist[u] + cap[i]) {
                cur[u] = i;
                long long f = dfs(to[i], min(flow, cost[i]));
                total_cost += f * cap[i];
                cost[i] -= f; cost[i ^ 1] += f;
                flow -= f;
                if (!flow) break;
            }
        }
        return pushed - flow;
    }
public:
    MinCostFlow() { memset(head, -1, sizeof(head)); memset(nxt, -1, sizeof(nxt)); }
    inline void add_edge(int u, int v, long long w, int c) {
        add_edge_raw(u, v, w, c);
        add_edge_raw(v, u, 0, -c);
    }
    long long dinic(int s, int t) {
        total_cost = 0; sink = t;
        while (spfa(s, t)) {
            memset(cur, -1, sizeof(cur));
            dfs(s, INF);

    int to, rev, cap;
    long long cost;
};
vector<Edge> graph[N];
int level[N], iter[N];
bool inq[N];
long long total_cost;
int sink;
void add_edge(int from, int to, long long cap, int cost) {
    graph[from].push_back((Edge){to, (int)graph[to].size(), (int)cap, cost});
    graph[to].push_back((Edge){from, (int)graph[from].size() - 1, 0, -cost});

    memset(level, -1, sizeof(level));
    memset(inq, 0, sizeof(inq));

    level[s] = 0; inq[s] = 1;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop(); inq[u] = 0;
        for (auto &e : graph[u]) {
            if (e.cap > 0 && (level[e.to] == -1 || level[e.to] > level[u] + e.cost)) {
                level[e.to] = level[u] + e.cost;
                if (!inq[e.to]) {
                    inq[e.to] = 1;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }

    while (spfa(s, t)) {
        memset(iter, 0, sizeof(iter));
        while (dfs(s, INF) > 0);
    }
    return total_cost;

    for (int i = 1; i <= kk; ++i) add_edge(s, (a[i] - 1) * 100 + 1, 1, 0);
